Question 8
?

The equation a2+8a=9 can be written in the form (a+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
p+q=−29,a=1 and a=−9
b
p+q=21,a=1 and a=−9
c
p+q=29,a=1 and a=9
d
p+q=21,a=1 and a=9
e
p+q=29,a=1 and a=−9
